String / entity matching.desc: case-sensitivity or wrong match operator (STRSTARTS vs CONTAINS vs case-insensitive regex)

Literal typing.desc: date literal typed 	exttt{xsd:date} while the graph stores 	exttt{xsd:dateTime}

Wrong predicate / value / scope.desc: transitive where direct was meant, wrong ELF code, or an over-cautious abstention

Result shape / aggregation.desc: COUNT/DISTINCT multiplicity or wrong columns returned (the compound abstention items)
